hero_heading: Find Government Schemes You May Be Eligible For
hero_subheading: Tell us about yourself and your business once. Yojna दृष्टि identifies verified government schemes, subsidies, and loans that match your profile.
disclaimer_trust: AI assists discovery & verification. Official government authorities make final sanction and eligibility decisions.
feature_matching_desc: Find government schemes based on your business stage, sector, income, and category.
feature_explainable_desc: Understand exactly why a scheme matches or why criteria are missing.
feature_documents_desc: Know required certificates and project reports before starting your application.
feature_partner_desc: Locate nearby bank branches and channelizing agencies that support your matched scheme.
feature_financial_desc: Estimate monthly EMI, loan tenure, subsidy discount, and moratorium period.
